Akki had been battling intense headaches again. The pressure in his brain was rising, and there was talk once more of tapping the CSF fluid to relieve it.
The same procedure we had tried in September 2022 at Hinduja Hospital one we had prayed would help ended up changing our lives forever.
He contracted a severe brain infection shortly after that CSF tap. An infection that damaged his brain even further. That moment, and everything that followed, became one of the darkest chapters of our lives.
Sometimes, no matter how much you love, how much you fight, how much you try to do everything “right,” life reminds you you’re not in control. And when it does, all you can do is bow your head to destiny.
We were confused, scared, and utterly torn. What was the right thing to do? How could we risk going down the same path again?
And then, almost like a quiet answer from the universe, Dr. Farokh Master came home.
Not on a call. Not on a video consult. He physically came home to see Akki my elder son.
Now, if you know anything about homeopathy, or about medicine at all, you’ll know what a miracle that is. Dr. Farokh Master is one of the busiest, most respected homeopaths in the world. People wait weeks, even months, to see him. He travels the globe teaching, treating, healing. And yet, here he was… in our home, with Akki.
It felt like something more than just good timing. It felt like divine intervention.
He walked in with calm energy, sat down, and listened carefully. He didn’t interrupt, didn’t jump to conclusions. He just listened. Then, after examining Akki, he looked at us and said with complete certainty
No. No manual CSF tap. Absolutely not.
There was a finality in his tone not harsh, but rooted.This boy has come back from the dead. He has fought what very few could survive. A brain infection, damage, trauma… and he’s still here. You cannot take another chance. Not again.
I didn’t need convincing after that.
Something in his voice, in his presence, settled everything inside me.
He said he would give homeopathy medicines to reduce the fluid and relieve the headaches and I trusted him completely and so did my children

Dandruff is a common scalp condition that can cause flaking, itching, and mild irritation. It may be influenced by factors such as dryness of the scalp, excess oil production, weather changes, stress, or sensitivity to certain hair care products. While it is not usually serious, it can affect comfort and self-confidence if persistent. 

Managing dandruff often requires understanding the underlying triggers and maintaining a consistent scalp care routine.
